name: Clipboard
description: A realtime shared clipboard. Paste text, screenshots or files on one device and they appear instantly on every other device in the room.

BLOB_BACKEND.description: Where uploaded files are stored. Must be 'postgres' on Heroku: a dyno's filesystem is wiped on every restart and deploy, so anything written to disk disappears.

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.description: Largest single upload, in bytes. Uploads consume Postgres storage on this platform, so the default is a conservative 10 MB rather than the 100 MB used with a disk volume.

RETENTION.description: How long an item survives before it and its file are deleted. Shorter keeps the database small.

SWEEP_INTERVAL.description: How often the expiry janitor runs.

DB_MAX_CONNS.description: Postgres connections per dyno. Essential plans allow 20 in total, and every dyno holds one of its share open to listen for events from the others, so keep quantity x DB_MAX_CONNS under your plan's limit.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to open a websocket. Set this to your app's URL (https://your-app.herokuapp.com) once you know it — the '*' default accepts upgrades from any origin.
